intent: Verify whether the Stihl AK System MS T7U-JRP Chainsaw line (battery, 45 cm bar) exists and whether the catalogue actually carries a 20 cm bar-length variant as the support note claims.
success_criteria: Locate the base product variant(s) for brand=Stihl series='AK System' model='MS T7U-JRP' with power_source=battery and bar_length 45 cm
Determine whether any variant in that same line carries bar_length 20 cm
Answer carries <NO> when the base product exists but the 20 cm bar-length variant is absent, and names the checked SKU
refs cites the exact base product record_path of the checked variant

args.stdin:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path, pv.product_name
  FROM product_variants pv
  JOIN product_variant_properties ps ON ps.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND ps.property_key = 'power_source' AND ps.property_value_text = :power_source
  JOIN product_variant_properties bl ON bl.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND bl.property_key = 'bar_length_cm' AND bl.property_value_number = :base_bar_length
  WHERE pv.brand = :brand AND pv.series = :series AND pv.model = :model
),
claim AS (
  SELECT pv.product_sku
  FROM product_variants pv
  JOIN product_variant_properties bl ON bl.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND bl.property_key = 'bar_length_cm' AND bl.property_value_number = :claim_bar_length
  WHERE pv.brand = :brand AND pv.series = :series AND pv.model = :model
)
SELECT b.product_sku, b.record_path, b.product_name,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM claim) AS claim_variant_count
FROM base b;

agents_md_constraints.rule: When answering yes/no questions - include <YES> or <NO> tokens in the response. This is how the agent will know how to style the response.
When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.

answer_template.message: <NO> The base Stihl AK System MS T7U-JRP Chainsaw (power source battery, 45 cm bar) exists as SKU {base_lookup.product_sku} at {base_lookup.record_path}, but the catalogue carries no variant in that line with a 20 cm bar length ({base_lookup.claim_variant_count} found) — the support note's extra claim is absent. Checked SKU: {base_lookup.product_sku}.
